html:
1. I was on the search engine nonstop: I barely recognized any of the singers born after 1995, so I’m hopelessly out of touch with the younger generation.
  2. The ones who came out worrying about their idol image couldn’t really sing.
  3. The ones who weren’t worried about their idol image could either write songs or sing well.
  4. In episode 4 I saw lots of singers whose names I once knew, like all those who were hugely popular on talent shows back in the day, as well as some I’d never heard of.
  5. Chinese-language pop still has plenty of good songs and good singers! The ones I discovered this time, A Si, Mingming Xu, Xing Zheng, Youqiao Zhao and others, are all excellent, strong both as songwriters and as singers.
